title: Two-item order charged the shipping fee twice

fingerprint.symptom: flat shipping fee added once per line instead of once per order
fingerprint.trigger: checkout of a cart with two different products under the free shipping minimum

bisect.subject: feat: price each cart line separately
bisect.author: demo-shop maintainer

root_cause.summary: checkout calls shippingFee() inside the per-line loop, so a cart with two lines pays the flat fee twice.

locations.reason: shipping is added inside the loop over lines

root_cause.fix_direction: Add the shipping fee once, after the loop, based on the order subtotal.
root_cause.ide_prompt:
Fix GitHub issue #9 in this repository.
Reproduction test: test/reprise/issue-9.test.js (get it with: git checkout origin/reprise/repro-9 -- test/reprise/issue-9.test.js).
Run it with: node --test --test-reporter=junit --test-reporter-destination=/out/junit.xml test/reprise/issue-9.test.js. It currently fails with: Expected values to be strictly equal: 139800 !== 129900
Likely cause: checkout calls shippingFee() inside the per-line loop, so a cart with two lines pays the flat fee twice.
Locations: src/cart.js lines 21–29
Introduced in 0465dd3 (feat: price each cart line separately).
Rules: do not modify test/reprise/issue-9.test.js; keep the change minimal; run the full suite with node --test --test-reporter=junit --test-reporter-destination=/out/junit.xml test/ before finishing; open a PR whose description contains "Fixes #9".
